angel-chiu.hair_colour: dark brown with honey-tea gold lightened ends
angel-chiu.body: She is slim with a soft, full curve at the bust that clearly shapes whatever she wears, above a narrow waist.

angeline-kwee.body: She is tall and slim with a noticeably full bust that fills the top of everything she wears, and a clearly narrower waist below it.

cheryl-soh.body: She is slim but distinctly full-chested, a soft heavy curve at the bust above a noticeably narrow waist, with long legs.

emma-kao.hair_colour: dark brown with one wine-red highlighted section
emma-kao.body: She is slim with a full, softly rounded bust that shapes the front of her clothes, above a defined waist.

jia-seo.hair_colour: cool grey-blue black with a mint-green under-layer
jia-seo.body: She is lean and athletic with a flat, strong midsection and a small defined waist, long legs and light muscle definition through the shoulders and thighs.

kanon-komori.hair_colour: dark at the roots fading to soft pink-lilac
kanon-komori.body: She is very petite and small-framed with short limbs and a low overall height, yet noticeably full-chested for her frame, which makes the contrast obvious in fitted clothes.

miu-shiraishi.body: She is petite and slight with narrow shoulders and a short frame, but full-chested enough that fitted tops sit tight across the front.

nanami-fujiwara.body: She is slim and evenly proportioned with a full, soft bust and a gently defined waist.

peggy-lee.hair_colour: deep wine-red with silver-grey highlighted strands
peggy-lee.body: She is curvy with a heavy full bust and wide hips that give her a strong hourglass line, and a clearly narrow waist between them.

rin-ayase.body: She is tall and curvy with a heavy full bust and a narrow waist, the proportions obvious even in structured clothing.

ruoruo-tang.body: She is lean and strong with visible long muscle through the arms and thighs, a flat controlled midsection and a moderate bust.

somi-oh.body: She is curvy with a heavy full bust and a soft rounded figure, but a clearly narrower waist that keeps the shape defined.

sydney-leong.body: She is short and softly built with a full rounded bust that fills the front of everything she wears, above a small waist.

tammy-chou.hair_colour: milk-tea gold-brown with lighter money-piece strands
tammy-chou.body: She is short and curvy with a full bust and rounded hips, and a small waist that makes the shape read strongly in fitted clothes.

wanyin-jiang.body: She is slim and long-limbed with an even, classical proportion, a moderate bust and a clearly defined waist.

wendy-yeo.body: She is slim with a full bust and a defined waist, the proportion obvious even under a shirt.

yerin-han.hair_colour: ash-brown with lighter gold face-framing highlights
yerin-han.body: She is tall and athletic with long legs, a full bust and light muscle definition through the shoulders and back.

zhiyi-shen.body: She is tall and slim with long legs, a full bust and a narrow waist that shows clearly in tailored clothes.

zoey-yeh.body: She is small and slight with narrow shoulders and a slender frame, and a modest bust in proportion to it.

nico-tsai.hair_colour: cool mid-brown with a silver-grey section at the left temple
nico-tsai.body: She is slim-framed with a full, rounded bust and a clearly narrow waist, the contrast between the two obvious in fitted clothes.
